priority: Syntactic and propositional validity BEFORE naturalness ranking or stylistic innovation.

hard_invalidators.failure: assistant describes the prompt instead of writing requested Korean passage (meta headers, lists, apologies)
contradicts a source event, agent/action, negation, comparison direction or stated numerical fact
turns unknown into observed, hypothesis into proved cause or unstated mental state into claimed fact
sentence becomes ungrammatical or semantically incoherent so readers cannot interpret it as intended prose
writing fails intended audience/narrator/genre at whole-document level

decision.meaning_first: A draft failing any decisive hard invalidator is not eligible for subtle AI-typical style preference ranking. This is a conditional inclusion criterion, not a training reward.
decision.retirement: Older KRC v0.1 samples and HTML survey retired. No human reader recruitment or preference estimand on those materials.
decision.baseline: Use competent general purpose Korean writing model under frozen clean prompt, not a 0.6B toy model and not an AI-authorship detector
decision.mechanical_limit: Regex can identify a suspicious meta label; it cannot certify semantic entailment, grammar or human idiomaticity
decision.criterion_for_restart: Pass task and source-fidelity floor on independent new prompts, THEN collect reader differences if meaningful.
counterfactual_rivals: surface ban only, if still scientifically relevant
decision.anti_drift: Study Korean writing rather than approval consensus or endless evaluator optimization.
